ios.desc:
Imagine ChatGPT coaching your runs. Let our AI make them engaging, accurate and effective.
 
Broccoli guides you through your training sessions via audio telling you if you're at the right intensity, when the next interval starts and keeping you motivated.

# Build your own training plan

Set a goal and time, and reach your peak at the right time without overtraining. 

# Connect your heart rate monitor

Broccoli supports connecting a heart rate monitor and having training personalized to you.

# Fits in your workflow

No need to change what apps you use or how you track. Broccoli works with your existing workflows.


Broccoli AI includes a Premium subscription. New users get 5h of workouts for free.

- The subscription is monthly.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Account settings at any time after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active period.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.eatbroccoli.app/privacy

show_hn.title: Show HN: Broccoli – LLM Guided Running Workouts for iOS

quotes.text: Hi HN! I've been building an iOS app to make my heart rate based running workouts more enjoyable - it gets your heart rate monitor data, gives it to an LLM and lets it talk to you throughout the workout via text to speech.
